bio: Department Associate Nutrition, Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health Departments Department of Nutrition My research is focused on elucidating the role of dietary patterns in cancer prevention and identifying potential biological mechanisms underlying associations of diet and cancer risk. I am specifically interested in mechanisms involving inflammation, insulin response and metabolomics, with colorectal cancer as a major endpoint. My current research efforts are supported by an R00 grant from the National Cancer Institute. Identification of circulating lipidomic biomarkers of malnutrition risk among oncology patients in the Total Cancer Care (TCC) Study: a cross-sectional analysis. Hoobler R, Maschek JA, Luo B, Murphy EA, Kubinak JL, Stewart PA, Cox JE, Chaix A, Woodruff K, Sanchez A, Coletta AM, Tabung FK, Gupta S, Hardikar S, Colman H, Playdon MC. medRxiv 2026 Jan 11 PMID: 41542690
